name: The Paratrooper
description: Binary system_updater.elf with crtime/mtime/atime identical to legitimate files in /usr/bin, but ctime (inode change time) from 3 hours ago — timestomping detected.

artifacts.description: Stat of binary: mtime=2024-03-15T10:00:00Z, atime=2024-03-15T10:00:00Z, crtime=2024-03-15T10:00:00Z (identical to /usr/bin/ls). ctime=2026-05-19T11:30:00Z (3h before detection).

caie_fractures.description: Recent ctime contradicts old mtime/atime/crtime: impossible without timestomping.

peirce_chain.firstness: Binary with timestamps identical to legitimate system files.
peirce_chain.secondness: Recent ctime reveals metadata modification; recently assigned inode; hash does not match official repository.
peirce_chain.thirdness: Habit of using timestomping to blend into the OS timeline, forgetting that ctime is immutable in user-space.

notes: Classic forensic timestomping: the attacker copied dates from a legitimate file but forgot to alter ctime.
